text: 10 OVERDOSAGE There is no known treatment to reverse the antiplatelet effect of ZONTIVITY, and neither dialysis nor platelet transfusion can be expected to be beneficial if bleeding occurs after overdose. Inhibition of platelet aggregation can be expected for weeks after discontinuation of normal dosing [see Clinical Pharmacology (12.2) ] . There is no standard test available to assess the risk of bleeding in an overdose situation.
